title: Show the Count
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about showing a count. Game-Maker cannot print a counter as a number, so each bulb adds one to the count and lights up: the row of lit bulbs is the count as pictures. A gate takes the whole count, and in the second level the gate is the exit. Signs in the levels say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and add a bulb.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie finds rows of dark bulbs. Each one adds to a count and lights up, so the lit bulbs show the count. The first gate takes five. In the second room the full meter opens the way out. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and add a bulb.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
Bulbs light up as they add to a count
Made to be copied and taken apart
